apps.name: PocketDocs
apps.tagline: Your personal, fully offline digital locker for important documents.
apps.description: Keep your Driving Licence, RC, Pollution Certificate, Insurance, Aadhaar, PAN, Passport and more organized in one place on your phone. Scan, store, share and get renewal reminders, with nothing ever uploaded to a server.

features.title: Scan like a scanner
features.text: Capture both sides, crop the corners and clean up with Grayscale, B&W or Enhanced filters.

features.title: 100% offline & private
features.text: No login, no account, no analytics. Every document stays on your device.

features.title: Renewal reminders
features.text: Set an expiry date and get a local reminder before a document lapses.

features.title: Share in one tap
features.text: Send documents as images or a combined PDF to WhatsApp, email or Drive.

features.title: App Lock
features.text: Protected by your phone's fingerprint, face unlock, PIN or pattern.

features.title: Document to Text
features.text: Extract English text from any scan, fully offline. Available in English, Hindi & Telugu.
